scripts.dev: concurrently "yarn workspace mailops-api start:dev" "yarn workspace mailops-web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace mailops-api build && yarn workspace mailops-web build
scripts.lint: yarn workspace mailops-api lint && yarn workspace mailops-web lint
scripts.git: git add . && git commit -m "Changes" && git push
scripts.release:patch: yarn build && yarn git && yarn version --patch && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: yarn build && yarn git && yarn version --minor && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: yarn build && yarn git && yarn version --major && git push --follow-tags
